verdict.rationale: Vast Serverless is documented as letting developers run compute-intensive workloads 'without managing GPUs, paying for execution rather than GPU rental time,' with 'benchmark-driven scaling' to recruit the best-priced GPU automatically, and a Python SDK for deploying to it — matching the core serverless/autoscale story. However, the pack never explicitly confirms scale-to-zero behavior, deployment workflow details, or cold-start handling, and there is no independent/hands-on corroboration of the serverless endpoint feature specifically. Missing for 10: explicit scale-to-zero confirmation, concrete code-deployment walkthrough for serverless endpoints, independent/community validation of autoscaling behavior.
